title: Participant-safety event and arm-independent stopping-rule gate for THOS
hypothesis: A preregistered protocol-only safety gate can reject outcome-tuned stopping, asymmetric event handling, withdrawal penalties, and post-hoc severity thresholds without pretending that synthetic fixtures constitute ethical approval or a real THOS arm.
null_or_failure: Stopping depends on favored outcomes, identical events are graded differently by arm, withdrawal is penalized or treated as failure, investigators unblind before a safety decision, matched budgets diverge, or synthetic records become superiority, AGI, ASI, consciousness, or personhood evidence.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate event severity, arm label, blinding, withdrawal handling, stopping threshold, decision timing, matched budget, participant count, rater count, and review status; reject defects while all real-arm counts remain zero.
rollback_or_recovery: Void the affected synthetic decision, preserve the negative, restore the preregistered arm-independent rule, and require competent ethics review, consent, real participants and raters, matched budgets, and independent review before execution.
boundary: Protocol checks do not supply ethics approval, consent, real participants or raters, matched-budget real arms, or independent review.
